alarm_status.description: "set" for an alarm set, or when a check finds alarms; "none" when a check finds none; "cancelled" after a cancel

alarm_time.description: The time an alarm was set for, as given; "" when none was given

alarm_date.description: The date an alarm was set for, as given; "" when none was given

alarm_times.description: The time of each alarm a check found or a cancel removed, oldest first

alarm_dates.description: The date of each alarm a check found or a cancel removed, oldest first; null for an alarm stored without one

alarm_count.description: How many alarms a check found

cancelled_count.description: How many alarms a cancel removed
